violation_type.title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers- Local Licensing Office Phone Number (26 TAC §746.405(4))
violation_type.short_title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers- Local Licensing Office Phone Number
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation does not have the updated licensing local number posted.

finding_variants.text: The operation does not have the updated licensing local number posted.
The correct contact infromation for the local Child Care Regulation office is not posted.
The local Licensing office telephone number is missing from the emergency numbers contact informaiton posting document.

Operation did not have the number to the local child care regulations/licensing office posted.    This was corrected at inspection when inspector provided phone number to director and director added the number to the emergency telephone numbers posted. Inspector also provided director with a copy of the emergency telephone numbers form 7243.  Director completed form and posted it.

While doing a walk through at the operation there was not a local Licensing office telephone number posted for parents to see. This was corrected at the inspection when contact numbers were posted on the parent board.
